content.text: All responsive audit language sits in § 22; no other Customer-binding audit, inspection, or records-verification right exists (§ 23 has no operative text).

input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit right binding us (Section 23 has a heading but no operative text, and no other inspection/verification right exists). It meets every preferred element: audits are limited to once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1); Vendor bears costs unless the audit establishes underpayment exceeding five percent, and Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly (22.2). Section 22.3 additionally makes findings our Confidential Information. No redline is warranted; this sits at the preferred position, above the fallback.
